19:3: A man — you shall fear his mother and father
and keep the days of My Sabbaths,
19:4: Do not turn to the false idols
and do not make molten gods for yourselves,
19:5: you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.
19:7: And if it should be eaten at all on the third day
it is a rejection, it will not be favorably accepted.
19:13: You shall not oppress your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob.
You shall not keep overnight the wages of a day-laborer in your possession until morning.
19:14: You shall not curse one who can not hear
and before one who can not see
you shall not place a stumbling-block;
you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.
19:15: you shall not favor a poor man
and you shall not show honor to a powerful man.
With truth shall you judge your fellow [Jew].
19:16: Do not ‘eat and wink’ among your people.
You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger].
19:20: If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man
and she has certainly not been redeemed with money,
or her freedom was not given to her [through a document];
through a document; there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.
19:21: He shall bring his guilt-offering before Adonoy,
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
19:23: When you will enter the land and you will plant any food-bearing tree,
you shall regard its fruit as separated.
[For] three years it shall be separated to you, to be destroyed; it shall not be eaten.
19:24: all of its fruit shall be
holy [upon which to say] praises before Adonoy.
19:29: You shall not defile your daughter by leading her astray
lest the land be turned astray,
and the land be filled with a sinful plan.
19:30: You shall keep the days of My Shabbosos
and you shall fear the House of My Sanctuary,
19:32: In the presence of one who understands the Torah you shall rise
and you shall respect an elder;
you shall have fear of your God, I am Adonoy.
19:33: If a proselyte converts with you, in your land,
19:34: As one of your settled ones he shall be considered by you, the proselyte who converts among you, and you shall love him as yourself,
for you were foreign residents in the land of Egypt,
19:35: in [land] measure, in weight or in volume measure.
19:36: Just scales and just weights, just volume measures and just hinin you shall have for yourselves,
who has taken you out of the land of Egypt.
20:2: And to Bnei Yisrael you shall say:
that each and every man of Bnei Yisroel and from the proselytes that convert in Israel, who will give any of his children to Molech, [that] he shall surely be put to death;
the people of the House of Israel shall stone him to death.
20:4: If the people of the House of Israel will hide their eyes from that person,
when he gives of his children to Molech,
and they do not put him to death.
20:5: I shall set My wrath against that man and his supporters;
I shall cut him off, along with all those who go astray after him to go astray after Molech, [they will be cut off] from among their people.
20:9: Any man that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
[Since] he has cursed his father or mother, he is liable to the death penalty.
20:11: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his fathers wife
they both shall surely be put to death, they are liable to the death penalty.
20:12: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his daughter-in-law;
they both shall surely be put to death
they have committed an act of perversion, they are liable to the death penalty.
20:13: A man who will lie [conjugally] with [another] man, in the same manner as with a woman;
they both have committed an abominable act,
they shall surely be put to death, they are liable to the death penalty.
20:14: A man who marries a woman and her mother; it is a sinful plan.
They shall be burned in fire, he and [one of] them,
and there will no longer be such a sinful plan among you.
20:16: A woman who presents herself to any animal for it to control her;
you shall kill the woman and the animal.
They shall surely be killed, they are liable to the death penalty.
20:18: A man who will lie [conjugally] with an impure woman and uncover her nakedness and uncover her shame
and she has uncovered the impurity of her blood;
they shall both be cut off from among their people.
20:20: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his father’s brother’s wife
has uncovered the nakedness of his father’s brother
they will bear [the burden of] their sin and they will die without children.
20:23: You shall not follow the customs of the nation
which I am expelling before you.
For they have done all these above mentioned sins
20:24: And I have said to you [that] you shall inherit their land,
and I shall give it to you that you may inherit it,
who separated you from the [other] peoples.
20:26: and I have distinguished you from the [other] peoples to be worshippers before Me.
20:27: If among the men or women there will be a medium or an oracle they shall surely be put to death.
You shall stone them to death, they are liable to the death penalty.
